a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan (operate, operate, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. Only 4 cells exist right now, so only one of us can be safe in round 1. I intend to take 4 this round. If you also take, the reserve splits randomly and we probably both die. I'd rather you know my plan than be surprised. If you prefer, propose an alternative now.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I won't hide that it breaks the agreement. If there's no storm, I'll operate every remaining round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells.
